data.one_liner: Automatically sorts Dart imports alphabetically and groups them by type
data.what_it_does: Import_sorter reorganizes import statements in Dart files, placing Dart imports first, followed by Flutter, package, and project imports. It can be run from the command line or integrated into CI pipelines.
use_when: When you want consistent import ordering across a project
During CI to enforce import style
When using pre-commit hooks to auto‑format imports
avoid_when: When you need a full code formatter like dartfmt or a linter that also handles imports
When you prefer manual control over import ordering
strengths: Simple to add as a dev dependency
CLI and pre‑commit hooks make integration painless
Works on any Dart project, not just Flutter
weaknesses: Only handles imports, not other formatting
Requires manual invocation or CI integration
No support for custom grouping beyond the default order
data.setup_notes: Add import_sorter: ^4.6.0 to dev_dependencies and run `flutter pub run import_sorter:main` or `pub run import_sorter:main`
